title: Algebraic Integer Quantization for Machine Learning Applications
abstract: arXiv:2610.12494v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this article, we propose algebraic integer number formats (AINF) as a framework for highly configurable and accurate compressed computation. A key property of AINF is its straightforward reduction to purely integer arithmetic, enabling error-free multiply-accumulate operations. We develop a matrix multiplication engine that exploits this property, obtaining performance within a predictable factor of the most efficient numerical counterparts on modern hardware accelerators. Another key advantage of AIQ is the freedom to select algebraic integers tailored to the numerical characteristics of a given use case, offering optimization opportunities that are fundamentally unavailable in floating-point or fixed-point formats. translated_title: 面向机器学习应用的代数整数量化
translated_abstract: 本文提出代数整数数格式（AINF）作为一种高度可配置且精确的压缩计算框架。AINF的一个关键特性是它能够直接化归为纯整数运算，从而实现无误差的乘累加操作。我们开发了一个利用这一特性的矩阵乘法引擎，在现代硬件加速器上获得了与最高效数值格式相比在可预测因子范围内的性能。AIQ的另一个关键优势在于可以自由选择适配特定用例数值特征的代数整数，提供了浮点或定点格式从根本上无法实现的优化机会。基于这些特性，我们提出了代数整数量化（AIQ），一种面向大语言模型（LLM）推理的有损压缩格式，并提供了实验结果证明AIQ能够实现具有竞争力的准确率。
tldr: 本文提出代数整数数格式（AINF）及面向大语言模型推理的代数整数量化（AIQ），该框架可将乘累加运算化归为纯整数运算以实现无误差计算，并允许针对具体应用灵活选择代数整数，在性能与精度上均具有竞争力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes algebraic integer number formats (AINF) and algebraic integer quantization (AIQ) for LLM inference, a framework that reduces multiply-accumulate operations to error-free pure integer arithmetic while allowing flexible selection of algebraic integers tailored to specific applications, achieving competitive performance and accuracy.
